in_hebrew.name: Pen
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Pen הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Penelope was a woman of exceptional wisdom and loyalty. Her name, Pen, is derived from the Greek word 'pen' which means 'feather' or 'write'. This name is a beautiful reminder of the power of words and the wisdom found in writing. In the New Testament, the name Pen appears as a surname for a scribe named Peniel, meaning 'face of God'.
